'''Ryo Fortress''' was [[Clan Ryo]]'s [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Shikaakwa]]. It was the seat of power of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] leader of the clan. After the [[Despot War]] the clan's leader was [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Volnos Ryo]] whose [[Volnos Ryo's father|father]] had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Hadiya]].

==Battle in Ryo Fortress==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,793 BBY]], a '''battle''' occurred in the [[Ryo Fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shikaakwa]] between the mad warrior [[Daegen Lok]] and his ally [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]], and a team of [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]] sent to capture the two. Lok, Xesh, and their captive [[Shae Koda]] arrived at Ryo Fortress to seek the support of [[Clan Ryo]] and its leader [[Volnos Ryo]], but the arrival of [[Je'daii Ranger]]s [[Hawk Ryo]] and [[Rori Fenn]], as well as the [[Je'daii Journeyer]] [[Sek'nos Rath]] and the stranger [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]], led to an all-out battle. The fighting ended when Xesh was convinced to side with the Je'daii by Koda, and Lok was captured and brought back to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

==Birth of the Dark Side of the Force==
After the [[Despot War]], Many Shikaakwa's including the Crime Lords abandoned the fortress and still believe in there hatred for the New [[Je'daii Order]] and wanted Revenge. A Mysterious dark cloaked Je'daii arrived on the planet and soon arrived in the abandoned fortress and discovered in ancient inscription within the fort that would give birth to the opposite of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light side of the Force]] which would be known as the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]].
